narrative.overview: A well-made printed workbook on warm paper: sand blocks and 1px hairlines instead of cards and shadows, square corners, one near-black action per view, and colour rationed to sun yellow and deep teal. Adapted from the Filko dashboard (Halo Lab) for a public Chinese site with system fonts and no purple.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper + sand paper + hairlines; square corners; no shadows.
One ink solid button per view; outline buttons invert on hover.
Two accents only: sun and teal; no purple, no subject colours.
Hairline rows led by 52px number boxes instead of cards; practice question groups are hairline sections.
Dark mode is a separate generated warm-black set; each colour lists canonicalDark.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Only sun and teal carry colour, each in its listed places.

rules.name: The No Purple Rule
rules.body: No token in OKLCH hue 270°–330° with chroma above 0.03; enforced by the tokens test.

rules.name: The Ink On Sun Rule
rules.body: Text and line art on sun is always sun-foreground.

rules.name: The Whole Sentence Rule
rules.body: Never colour one line of a headline.

rules.name: The Mainland Reach Rule
rules.body: System fonts only; nothing unreachable from mainland China.

dos: Separate content with sand blocks and hairlines.
Keep exactly one ink solid button per view.
Label free and quota with the dot chip and text before the action.
Run the tokens test after any colour change.
donts: No shadows, rounded cards, pills or segmented controls.
No per-subject colours; no coloured headline lines; no coloured primary button.
No web fonts; no exam English brand name; never style the exam mode with this system.
